en: A monochrome vintage postcard showing an old stone doorway with a rounded Romanesque/Gothic arch and worn steps leading up to a heavy wooden door. Above the entrance is a carved coat of arms. To the right is a metal fence and climbing vegetation on the wall. The lower front margin bears a printed caption in red identifying the location as Meissen and specifying it as an entrance to the castle area.
